I'm an instructor in Electrical and Computer Engineering at Oregon State University,
with industry, research, and teaching experience in analog and mixed-signal circuits
and system-level design. I lead undergraduate teams through Oregon
State's Junior Design sequence, guiding students through iterative, project-based
learning, and I enjoy mentoring future engineers through hands-on instruction and
real-world design challenges.
